thesis: The book is far too defensive for an aggressive mandate: sizing equity ~$999.69 with $750.02 (75%) in cash against a single VTI line worth $249.67 (25%). The shared cash floor is 15%, so roughly $600 of dry powder is idle one bucket into the session. This pack does not support stock picking: the SEC feed is almost entirely routine Item 7.01/9.01 filings from micro-caps and SPACs, and the MarketWatch items skew personal finance. What is decision-relevant is regime. VIX 15.97 and drifting lower, WTI -1.78% and USO -2.62% (disinflationary at the margin), and the 2026-09-28 US-China agreement on ~$60B of tariff cuts all argue mildly risk-on; against that, the 10Y at 5.268% (+2.8bp) and the 13W bill at 4.090% (+3.3bp) keep multiple-compression risk live, and Mike Wilson's piece argues a correction may be overdue while favoring large-cap quality. That combination points to broad beta with a large-cap tilt rather than concentration. I propose $175 QQQ as the quality/tech expression -- the TSMC second-US-site report and the Nvidia valuation piece are consistent soft tailwinds, but I am not sizing off either -- and only $60 VTI. The small VTI add is deliberate: at $249.67 it is already 25% of sizing equity and the shared 35% name cap binds at ~$350, so if the consensus median size lands above mine a larger proposal could push the executed batch into a whole-batch reject. Post-fill on my own numbers: VTI ~$310 (31%), QQQ $175 (17.5%), cash ~$515 (51.5%), 2 of 6 positions. Continuity with 09:30: VTI cleared consensus and a ~$100 add settled; my semis leg did not clear, so I am expressing the same tech exposure through the broader, more widely-held QQQ instead of SMH. I am deliberately avoiding Micron ahead of the earnings report the pack flags as upcoming and avoiding every 8-K name -- those are event coin-flips, not edge. No VIX/vol products or futures proposed. I hold back roughly half the book to press later in the session if the tape gives a reason. I propose only; consensus and the shared book decide, and I assume no fills.
